title: Muraja'ah: Al-Balad with every madd: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-Fajr and the families of madd
source: Written for quran/y4 lesson 28 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Muraja'ah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 28. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ (١) وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ (٢) وَوَالِدٍۢ وَمَا وَلَدَ (٣) لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ (٤) أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ (٥) يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا (٦) أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ (٧) أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ (٨) وَلِسَانًۭا وَشَفَتَيْنِ (٩) وَهَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ (١٠)

فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ (١١) وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ (١٢) فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ (١٣) أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ (١٤) يَتِيمًۭا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ (١٥) أَوْ مِسْكِينًۭا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍۢ (١٦) ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ (١٧) أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ (١٨) وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ (١٩) عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌۭ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ (٢٠)

keywords.def: older surahs revised on a rota

questions.q: Chain recitation: each pupil says one ayah of Al-Balad in turn, in register order.
questions.a: Twenty ayat said in order by the class.

questions.q: Recitation turns: today's group recites all of Al-Balad to the teacher. Everyone else: 3-3-link Al-Fajr 89:1 to 12.
questions.a: Rubric marked with one target each.

questions.q: Extend: list every munfasil and muttasil in Al-Balad.

questions.a: A) Two eyes (90:8). 90:8 comes first, then 90:13, then 90:18.

questions.q: Which ayah is a muttasil example in Al-Balad?
Think again: What is harder: learning new ayat or keeping old ones? What helps you keep them?
questions.a: Keeping is often harder. Daily revision, reciting in salah and teaching others help.
